answer: I would anchor trust in Dental hygienist licence with health board attestation. With a licence number in the health board register, a single nectar check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a licence number in the health board register is bound to a single identity — the nadir is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The grove grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
